  • Excel avançado e sistemas de gestão ERP;
  • Noções em formação de preços e margens comerciais;
  • Noções de tributação aplicada ao setor de distribuição.


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Orientação para o cliente: Apresentar olhar voltado para experiência do cliente e estimular seus pares para o mesmo. Realiza promessas factíveis de cumprir. Fornece retorno ao cliente de acordo com o combinado;
  • Foco em Resultados: Assume responsabilidades pelas entregas e cumpre prazos. Busca soluções criativas para os problemas apresentados. Apresenta visão sistêmica. Consegue administrar a pressão e frustração. Apresenta histórico de sucesso no cumprimento de metas e entrega de resultados. Apresenta disciplina em ser treinado e direciona seus pares para cumprir script de vendas: análise de oportunidade de vendas, venda consultiva, tem bons argumentos e se prepara para as principais objeções;
  • Disposição para mudanças: Investe em seu desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental. Sabe ouvir e modifica o comportamento a partir de feedbacks. É flexível a novas formas de trabalho. Apresenta energia e “espírito positivo”;
  • Comunicação e Relacionamento interpessoal: Comunica-se com clareza e objetividade. Respeita a expressão de diferentes pontos de vista. Mantém bom relacionamento com equipe, pares e superiores; apresentando inteligência emocional no dia a dia.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.

title: Especialista VMO
description:
QUEM SOMOS?

A Fundación MAPFRE, instituição sem fins lucrativos, é a nossa acionista majoritária, o que fortalece a nossa independência e estabilidade. Entre nossos compromissos está a valorização e apoio à diversidade e inclusão, construindo ambientes mais acolhedores.

A presença de mulheres em cargo de gestão, a contratação de PCDs e o equilíbrio racial e de gênero na constituição das equipes é a nossa prioridade.


QUEM QUEREMOS NO NOSSO TIME


Pessoas proativas e inovadoras, capazes de identificar de forma contínua novas oportunidades e soluções para transformar algo bom em algo melhor;

Que colaborem, porque a capacidade de cooperar, contribuir e compartilhar com pessoas que têm pontos de vista diferentes nos ajudará a conseguir melhores resultados;

Que tenham curiosidade para aprender, se desenvolver, crescer e sentir que estão contribuindo aos objetivos da empresa.

LOCAL DE TRABALHO: SÃO PAULO/ W Torre -SP (3 dias presenciais e 2 dias trabalho remoto)

title: Systems Engineer
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.


This role will cover either our open B (4PM - 12PM) and C (12PM-8AM) shift as well as weekends.


Job Summary:

The Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the deployment of complete systems that include Clever Devices products combined with complementary technologies, including deployment of hardware products and interfaces, to provide a holistic solution that meets customer requirements.

The Systems Engineer works closely with the project team to analyze the customer requirements and required functionality early in the project cycle; create design documents, system architecture, requirement matrix and support the customer design reviews, conduct the Factory Acceptance Testing with the customer and lead the subsequent deployment at the Customer site. Execute and complete the System Acceptance Testing along with the customer and all other parties involved in the project

The Systems Engineer coordinates all system development and integration tasks to include design, integration and formal testing. The Systems Engineer also works to support the Systems Engineering team.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supports the definition of software and hardware products and interfaces
  • Coordinates system development tasks to include design, integration and formal testing
  • Oversees all transitions into customer’s deployment
  • Develops and completes projects in system specifications, technical and logistical requirements and other disciplines
  • Creates and maintains programmatic and technical documentation (design docs, requirement matrix, system diagrams, etc) to insure efficient planning and execution
  • Manages and documents system configurations
  • Ensures the deployment of the solution is successful
  • Maintains a thorough working knowledge of enterprise applications such as BusTime and CleverCAD
  • Implements Performance analysis and reliability analysis of the end to end protocol
  • Adheres to protocol revisions and amendments as directed by the Regional Systems Engineering Manager
  • Assists in other tasks as needed by the Systems Engineering department
  • Provides training and guidance to Associates, Project Engineer I/II as needed.


Skills Required:

  • 10+ years experience in engineering development
  • 10+ years experience in systems engineering involving hardware, software, data and communications technologies
  • Good understanding of the J1939 and J1708 protocols and experience with Multiplex systems
  • Hardware design experience and ability to read electrical schematics
  • Experience with hardware troubleshooting and lab equipment
  • Experience with network and protocol troubleshooting and tools
  • Working knowledge of one or more of the following: C and C++, SQL, VB, JavaScript, HTML, ASP, python, databases, report generation and networking
  • Ability to independently gather and document requirements and provide design requirements and product definition
  • Strong computer skills particularly with MS Office including Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint and Project.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize
  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Bachelors Degree in Engineering or Computer Engineering required, Masters Degree in related discipline.
  • Experience working with public transit is a plus

title: Data Scientist
description:
DYWIDAG stands as a global leader in construction and infrastructure technology that works with government authorities, asset owners, construction companies, and design offices to support their infrastructure projects. We have expanded into over 50 countries worldwide and continue to keep infrastructure safe and secure every single day.


Purpose of the Job

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of hands-on experience as a data scientist in a business environment, supporting multiple departments and functions with predictive analytics and rapid development of minimal viable products (MVPs). A strong emphasis is placed on experience with pricing engines and sales forecasting solutions. You will be responsible for analyzing large datasets, building predictive models, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured data from diverse sources.
  • Develop, implement, and optimize statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques.
  • Rapidly prototype and deliver MVPs to address business needs, especially in pricing and sales forecasting.
  • Collaborate with the Global BI Team and cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.
  • Support various departments (e.g., Sales, Finance, Operations) with tailored predictive models and insights.
  • Visualize data insights using dashboards and reports, primarily with Power BI.
  • Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders through presentations and documentation.
  • Continuously improve data quality, analytical processes, and model performance.
  • Stay current with the latest trends and technologies in data science, machine learning, and AI.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of proven experience as a data scientist in a business setting, supporting multiple departments/functions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in developing predictive models for pricing engines and sales forecasting.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, especially Power BI.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure cloud platforms is preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Spark, Hadoop).
  • Knowledge of deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Industry experience in Construction is preferred; experience in Manufacturing or Engineering-related Big Data is also relevant.

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.


Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.


Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
PROJECT QUALITY ENGINEER

Reports to: Quality Coordinator


Role Summary

- Assists with the interpretation of project-specific Quality Assurance requirements, verifies Quality Assurance plan implementation, and evaluates effectiveness by audits and assessments.

- Responsible for verification of design, procurement, manufacturing, site activities, tests, inclusion of appropriate inspections and their acceptance criteria into project documentation that will be deployed into the Supply Chain.

- Ensure that Quality is being incorporated into projects and processes (prevention), rather than inspected.


Key tasks of the Position

  • Reviews customers’ specifications, further legal / statutory requirements (Q related) and compare to industries standards aiming to identify main relationships and differences (if any), ensure proper requirements' management and compliance.
  • Reviews / issues project-specific Quality Plans and documentation (e.g.: Inspection & Test Plans, etc).
  • Supports, facilitates, reviews and releases project-specific Design & Process FMEAs, verification and validation reports, ensuring proper method application, risk analysis & classification, actions definition and their implementation.
  • Ensure project lessons learned (positive and negative) are produced and management system changes are implemented, as necessary.
  • Supports the development of project-specific sourcing & manufacturing strategies and schedules, ensuring that all relevant quality activities and requirements are considered and consistent to the strategies.
  • Participates on key project related meetings (e.g.: Design reviews) providing quality related input;
  • Ensure through process audits & verifications (e.g., at Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Field Services) and based on project-specific data analysis that quality is being incorporated in processes.
  • Drives, supports, and facilitates continuous improvement activities (e.g., at Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Field Services) based on project-specific data analysis.
  • Performs Technical Committee meetings prior components' release for shipping.
  • Supports, review and releases the Project-specific Quality Data book
  • Monitor the Project Quality Budget and to inform the Project Manager and the Project Quality Coordinator accordingly (eg compliance with Sales Forecast value; proceeding in case of deviations).


Additional responsabilities

  • Supports, on demand and based on his/her capabilities, Quality department's tasks & priorities defined by the Quality Engineering Coordinator & Head of Quality
  • Occasional Business Trips: ~ 20% of time


Decision-Making Powers

  • Full empowerment for rejection or blockage of processes and/or components when those are not compliant to the expected Quality requirements.
  • Power of tasks assignment (e.g.: start of a problem-solving activity) based on project-specific data analysis


EMPLOYEE PROFILE


Professional Experience & Education

  • Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Material, as applicable) or equivalent.
  • Postgraduate in Business Administration (desirable).
  • Relevant work experience in Quality Management & Quality Engineering.
  • Relevant professional experience and knowledge in business processes as well as in non-quality functions like Manufacturing, Logistics, Engineering, Purchasing.
  • Certified Lead Auditor (e.g. ISO 9001 and ISO 19011) (desirable).
  • Qualification in electrical and/or, dimensional and/or, NDT testing (desirable).


Specific Skills & Knowledge (Ex: Language, IT skills)

  • Practical knowledge in using IT-tools: SharePoint, SAP, MS Office, database tracking programs.
  • Good Lean Management background is an advantage.
  • Management and communication skills (incl. but not limited to interpersonal, listening, verbal, written, didactic and presentation).
  • English fluent, written and spoken (additional languages are an advantage).
  • Strong analytical expertise as well as result-oriented, solution driven (pragmatic) and customer oriented working principle.
  • Experienced and willingness to work and cooperate in cross functional teams

Nossa missão é não só cuidar dos pacientes, mas também gerar e compartilhar conhecimento, oferecendo um ambiente de crescimento e oportunidades igualitárias para nossos profissionais.

Contamos com um time de 5.000 pessoas que fazem daqui um dos “Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar”, segundo a FIA|Estadão.

Confira as especificações da vaga e envie seu currículo.

Junte-se a nós e faça parte dessa história de transformação.

Garantir eficiência dos fluxos operacionais e otimizar processos internos.

Monitorar entregas e SLAs regulatórios, assegurando compliance com padrões nacionais e internacionais.

Gestão de Qualidade e Regulatória

Garantir aderência às normas GCP/ICH, ANVISA, CONEP e CEP.

Liderar ou apoiar auditorias internas e externas, inspeções e processos de CAPA.

Implementar práticas de melhoria contínua em qualidade e segurança operacional.

Fomentar cultura colaborativa entre as diversas áreas envolvidas.

title: Tecnologista de Produção Pleno (Foco em Transferência de Tecnologia)
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?

O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.


Aqui no Butantan, valorizamos a diversidade.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, que se traduz no respeito à diversidade de gênero, etnia, pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual (LGBTQIAPN+), crenças e religiões. Buscamos pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores e que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto com a instituição.


Buscamos um(a) profissional que atuará como Tecnologista de Produção Pleno, em projeto da vacina contra a Hepatite A (Foco em Transferência de Tecnologia):


  • Executando, orientando e garantindo a execução das diversas etapas da produção, desenvolvimento e etapas auxiliares do Laboratório, incluindo a preparação de soluções e meios de cultura.
  • Operando, limpando, orientando e assegurando a limpeza de equipamentos específicos conforme os procedimentos.
  • Acompanhando a manutenção, calibração e qualificação de equipamentos, bem como a validação de processos e limpeza.
  • Conferindo os materiais utilizados no processo, verificando validade e o adequado armazenamento.
  • Efetuando monitoramento ambiental em área classificada e enviando o material ao Serviço de Controle de Qualidade.
  • Elaborando, revisando e conferindo a documentação de projetos (POPs, ERUs, formulários, etc.).
  • Preenchendo os formulários referentes aos procedimentos realizados.
  • Utilizando e assegurando o uso de vestimenta e equipamentos de proteção individual/coletivo apropriados em áreas classificadas.
  • Operando o sistema ERP para realizar os apontamentos de lotes de produção.
  • Qualificando operadores, visando a habilitação para atuar em área classificada.
  • Realizando testes de controle de processo de produção, ensaios e experimentos para a melhoria e controle da cadeia produtiva.
  • Auxiliando em ensaios de processos e novas metodologias para o desenvolvimento de novos produtos.
  • Realizando o desenvolvimento de novos produtos e implementando melhorias de produção.
  • Cumprindo com as normas de BPF (Boas Práticas de Fabricação) e os procedimentos operacionais.


Quais são os requisitos imprescindíveis para essa vaga:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em: Bioengenharia; Biologia; Biomedicina; Ciência e Tecnologia; Ciências Biológicas; Ciências Biomoleculares; Ciências da Saúde; Engenharia Biomédica; Engenharia de Manufatura; Engenharia de Produção; Engenharia Química; Farmácia (ou Bioquímica); Microbiologia e Imunologia; Nanobiotecnologia; Química; Química Industrial; Automação Industrial; Biotecnologia e Gestão da Qualidade.
  • Desejável: Vivência com BPF, tech transfer, upstream (cultivo celular) e downstream (purificação), elaboração de POPs e ERUs;
  • Inglês Intermediário.


Nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Oportunidade de carreira e desenvolvimento;
  • Convênio Médico e convênio odontológico;
  • Plano de Previdência Complementar
  • TotalPass;
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo;
  • Cartão Ifood Benefícios;
  • Refeitório no local;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Ônibus fretado- Instituto Butantan/Metrô- Metrô/Instituto Butantan;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Auxílio para filho(a) com deficiência;
  • Auxílio para compra de material escolar;
  • Subsídio de medicamentos;
  • Parcerias na área Educacional e Entretenimento;
  • Acesso aos museus do Instituto Butantan;
  • Day Off de aniversário.


Informações complementares:

  • Período de inscrições: 05/12/2025 a 12/12/2025
  • Quantidade de vaga(s): 01
  • Local de Trabalho: São Paulo - Brasil
  • Horário/escala de trabalho: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 07h às 16h
  • Modelo de trabalho: Presencial


Como serão as etapas do nosso processo seletivo:

O processo seletivo será composto pelas seguintes etapas:

  • Análise curricular e triagem de candidatos;
  • Entrevista com recrutadores;

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
We’re searching for a Salesforce Sales Cloud expert who also brings solid hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ. In this role, you’ll architect and deliver solutions that simplify sales operations, improve quoting accuracy, and support a smoother customer journey. You’ll work across multiple teams to refine processes, automate routine tasks, and strengthen the overall sales technology ecosystem.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead consultant for designing, configuring, and rolling out enhancements across Sales Cloud and CPQ.
  • Work with business stakeholders to understand their goals and translate them into well-structured Salesforce solutions.
  • Configure core Sales Cloud components—including lead management, opportunity tracking, account and contact management, product and pricing setup, and the full quoting lifecycle.
  • Build and manage CPQ elements such as product bundles, pricing rules, discount logic, and end-to-end quote generation.
  • Create workflow automation through Flows, approvals, validation rules, and occasional Apex development.
  • Support integrations between Salesforce and other platforms such as ERP, billing, or marketing systems using APIs or middleware.
  • Oversee testing cycles, guide users through UAT, and deliver training to ensure smooth adoption.
  • Troubleshoot post-deployment issues and continually look for ways to improve system performance and usability.
  • Monitor Salesforce and CPQ updates to ensure the organization benefits from new features and best practices.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in technology, computer science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years working with Salesforce Sales Cloud in a configuration or implementation role.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on Salesforce CPQ experience.
  • Strong command of Sales Cloud data structures, platform capabilities, and standard functionality.
  • In-depth knowledge of CPQ configuration principles including product setup, pricing, discounting, and quoting mechanics.
  • Experience with Apex, Visualforce, LWCs, or integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi) is a plus.
  • Salesforce Admin, Sales Cloud, and CPQ certifications are preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to break down complex technical concepts for business users.

title: Gerente SHE
description:
O Gerente de SHE é responsável pela implementação, otimização e gestão de processos da área de Segurança do Trabalho dentro de uma organização. Ele garante que a operação dos serviços seja eficientes, alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos da área.


  • Assegurar o atendimento aos requisitos legais e corporativos aplicáveis a segurança do trabalho, objetivando a não ocorrência de acidentes e não conformidades.
  • Avaliar as condições ambientais de trabalho (riscos físicos), emitir relatório técnico e indicar medidas de controle.
  • Atuar imediatamente qualquer atividade que apresente risco grave e iminente de acidente do trabalho ou doença ocupacional.
  • Identificar e analisar riscos, acidentes e falhas, investigar as causas e propor medidas preventivas e corretivas para prevenir potenciais incidentes e/ou acidentes.
  • Acompanhar peritos e auditores nas avaliações ambientais e fiscalizações trabalhistas.
  • Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas do sistema integrado de gestão de acordo com as normas ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001. Garantir o atendimento ao plano de ação das observações e não conformidades registradas.
  • Monitorar os dados estatísticos de acidentes do trabalho, doenças profissionais e do trabalho, calcular a frequência e a gravidade.
  • Assegurar a gestão de equipe sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Promover a comunicação entre a Segurança e a gerência/diretoria dos sites.
  • Oferecer suporte ao negócio ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto desde o planejamento, supervisão, monitoramento e documentação para assegurar a conformidade com os aspectos internos, externos e legais relacionados.


Requisitos:

  • Formação específica como engenheiro e com Pós-graduação em Segurança do Trabalho (habilitação nacional para o exercício da sua função).
  • Experiência com implantação de sistemas de gestão em Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente e/ou Liderança de Projetos na área.
  • Experiência com NR’s.
  • Experiência com clientes do ramo de logística.
  • Experiência em gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas, aplicação de treinamentos, direção e experiência para ajudar a resolver desafios.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas Google Office, Microsoft Office, Power BI (será um diferencial).
  • Fluência em espanhol.


Atividades:

  • Elaborar os procedimentos, padrões, normas e instruções de trabalho para o desenvolvimento do serviço nos clientes.
  • Identificar requisitos legais e do cliente e integrá-los em documentos operacionais.
  • Treinar e capacitar equipe operacional.
  • Definir e elaborar os indicadores de segurança, gestão de serviços e implementar planos de melhoria.
  • Assessorar a equipe de supervisores e técnicos de segurança sobre riscos, controles e ações para garantir o cumprimento das normas do cliente.
  • Assessorar o cliente no cumprimento regulatório e requisitos legais.
  • Realizar auditorias de gestão e cumprimento das normas de serviço de acordo com os requisitos do plano anual de auditoria.


Perfil: liderança, organização, controle, orientação para resultados, desenvolvimento de pessoas e comunicação eficaz.

title: Analista de Treinamento & Desenvolvimento SR
description:

Oferecemos soluções de administração de apólice de ponta a ponta, com experiência SaaS.

Acreditamos que a simplicidade e agilidade são as chaves para a eficácia, ao tornar processos e experiências acessíveis e descomplicadas.

Hoje, temos mais de 270 colaboradores que fazem acontecer e +40 seguradoras que aproveitam os benefícios de nossos produtos e serviços!

Em 2024, pelo quarto ano consecutivo, recebemos a certificação do Great Place to Work (GPTW).


i4pro + você = i4evc

· Planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento (presenciais e online), alinhados às necessidades do negócio.

· Levantar necessidades de capacitação e desenvolvimento junto às áreas, utilizando análise de gaps, feedbacks e indicadores.

· Desenvolver conteúdos internos e adaptar materiais para diferentes públicos, garantindo didática e engajamento.

· Gerenciar parceiros e fornecedores para treinamentos técnicos e comportamentais.

· Participar de iniciativas de clima e engajamento , apoiando análise de resultados e planos de ação.

· Realizar benchmarking sobre práticas de T&D e desenvolvimento no mercado.

· Estimular ações de desenvolvimento através dos Planos de Desenvolvimento Individuais dos colaboradores e liderança.

· Mapear potencial, pessoas chaves, posições críticas e plano de sucesso.

· Revisar ou criar políticas e manuais de T&D , assegurando padronização dos processos.

· Mapear melhorias no ciclo de performance realizando as implementações a cada ciclo, realizar definição do cronograma e assegurar realização das etapas, acompanhar calibrações.


Você também precisa ter:


· Metodologias de T&D e desenvolvimento (andragogia, trilhas de aprendizagem, programas de liderança, pesquisa de clima, avaliação de desempenho).

· Gestão de projetos aplicada a treinamentos e desenvolvimento.

· Domínio em plataformas LMS e ferramentas digitais de aprendizagem.

· Conhecimento básico de ferramentas de avaliação de desempenho e feedback.

· Pacote Office avançado (Excel e PowerPoint).

· Comunicação clara e habilidade de facilitação.

· Ensino Superior completo (Psicologia, Administração, Pedagogia, ou áreas correlatas).



Se você tiver, será um diferencial:

· Desejável inglês intermediário (para contato com fornecedores ou conteúdos).


Nosso modelo de trabalho:


Priorizamos o bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores, com posições em formato remoto, presencial ou híbrido, que é definido conforme as necessidades da vaga e as atribuições do cargo.

No caso dessa posição, a atuação é de forma presencial com política de home office, 2x por semana no nosso escritório.


Nosso escritório fica na Avenida Angélica, 2133 – próximo do metrô Paulista.


O seu bem-estar é a nossa prioridade, portanto oferecemos:

· Vale Refeição;

· Vale Alimentação;

· Plano Médico Sulamérica;

· Plano Odontológico Sulamérica;

title: Legal Counsel
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Scope : Senior executive officer responsible for the overall management and legal representation of the company in Brazil, ensuring full compliance with applicable laws and regulations, alignment with group strategy, and sound governance, risk and control frameworks. Acts as the company’s legal representative alongside other three directors before public authorities, regulators, financial institutions and key partners.


Key responsibilities : • Corporate management: lead the implementation of the business plan in Brazil, follow HQ priorities and ensure operational and financial targets are met. • Legal representation: act as the company’s legal representative before the Central Bank of Brazil and other regulators, tax authorities, courts, financial institutions, partners and suppliers, signing contracts, powers of attorney and corporate documents. • Regulatory relationship: maintain a constructive and transparent relationship with Brazilian regulators and self-regulatory bodies, including responding to inspections, official inquiries and information requests. • Financial stewardship: approve budgets according to HQ instructions, monitor cash flow, capital and liquidity needs, and ensure timely and accurate financial according to the finance team and regulatory reporting. • People and culture: build and lead the local leadership team, promote an ethical culture, and ensure adherence to the company’s code of conduct and policies, acting in a horizontal relationship alongside officers responsible for AML/CFT, Internal Controls & Compliance, and Risk, Capital & Disclosure.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional experience, with solid background in financial services, payments, fintech and/or crypto, including prior experience in leadership or management roles;
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape applicable to the business (Central Bank of Brazil, COAF and, where relevant, CVM and other authorities).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering or a related field; a MBA or similar is a plus.
  • Proven leadership, stakeholder-management and decision-making skills, with a hands-on, ownership mindset.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must be resident in Brazil.
  • No disqualifying factors as described below:

I — not to be barred by special law, nor convicted of bankruptcy crimes, tax evasion, malfeasance, active or passive bribery, extortion, embezzlement, crimes against the popular economy, public faith, property, or the National Financial System, nor sentenced to a penalty that prohibits, even temporarily, access to public office;

II — not to have been declared disqualified or suspended from serving in statutory or contractual bodies at institutions authorized to operate by the Central Bank of Brazil or at pension entities, insurance companies, capitalization companies, publicly held companies, or entities subject to the supervision of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Brazil (CVM);

III — not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;

IV — unblemished reputation;

V — knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;

VI — technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: PM/PO Sênior
description:
Sobre a Consorciei

Somos a fintech líder no mercado de consórcios e estamos transformando a indústria com tecnologia e capital.


Desenvolvemos plataformas whitelabel e soluções com IA generativa que trazem eficiência às administradoras e uma experiência digital completa para os clientes — do momento da compra até o pós-venda.


⚙️Sobre o produto:

Estamos lançando um novo produto de cobrança com IA generativa para recuperação de clientes do consórcio, elevando a taxa de recuperação, eficiência operacional e experiência do cliente.


  • Plataforma de cobrança conversacional com IA generativa para contato ativo e passivo e negociação com clientes em atraso (1–3 parcelas);
  • Integração com as bases das administradoras para ingestão de carteiras, aplicação de regras de negociação e atualização de status;
  • Emissão/captura de boleto e código Pix, envio ao cliente, conciliação e atualização automática de pagamento;
  • Orquestração multicanal (por exemplo: WhatsApp, SMS, e-mail; futuramente voz) e acompanhamento de promessas de pagamento;
  • Painéis de performance, experimentação (A/B) e régua de cobrança configurável.



Missão do cargo:

Liderar a evolução e o sucesso do produto de cobrança com IA da Consorciei, desde discovery até scale-up, garantindo adoção pelas administradoras, performance de recuperação e experiência superior para clientes finais.


Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Definir visão do produto, objetivos trimestrais e roadmap orientado a resultados de negócio (recovery rate, conversão, tempo de recebimento);
  • Conduzir entrevistas e acompanhamentos com administradoras e clientes finais, mapear jornadas, desenhar régua de cobrança e experiências conversacionais seguras e eficazes;
  • Priorizar backlog, escrever user stories/critérios de aceite, acompanhar o desenvolvimento com Tecnologia/IA/Design e garantir qualidade (UAT e go-live);
  • Definir KPIs, instrumentar analytics, criar e analisar experimentos, identificar alavancas de conversão e oportunidades de melhoria contínua;
  • Coordenar integrações com sistemas das administradoras, provedores de mensagens (CPaaS), meios de pagamento e conciliação;
  • Realizar demonstrações para administradoras, apoiar propostas, POCs e pilotos;
  • Liderar implantação, parametrização de regras de negociação/régua, monitorar resultados, criar playbooks e suportar equipes das administradoras;
  • Comunicar progresso, riscos e decisões; promover alinhamento e transparência;
  • Estabelecer SLAs, métricas de confiabilidade, gestão de incidentes e documentação do produto.



Requisitos obrigatórios pra vaga:

  • PO/PM em produtos digitais, preferencialmente fintech, bancos, meios de pagamento ou crédito;
  • Vivência em produtos B2B ou B2B2C, com integrações via APIs e implantação em clientes enterprise;
  • Forte domínio de métricas de produto e de funil de cobrança (contato, engajamento, promessa, pagamento, recuperação);
  • Experiência com discovery, priorização por impacto, escrita de user stories e condução de squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Conforto com dados: definir KPIs, analisar e gerar relatórios;
  • Excelente comunicação e escrita;
  • Inglês(básico/intermediário) para leitura técnica;


✨Diferenciais:

  • Experiência direta em cobrança/recuperação de crédito (régua de cobrança, negociação);
  • Vivência com administradoras de consórcios ou produtos para esse segmento;
  • Experiência com produtos de IA generativa/conversacional (LLMs, prompt design, guardrails, avaliação);
  • Conhecimento de WhatsApp Business API, provedores CPaaS (ex.: Zenvia, Twilio), CRMs e contact center;

Pra nossas pessoas

A gente acredita que cuidar de quem faz a Consorciei acontecer é o que impulsiona o nosso crescimento.

Estamos no modelo hibrido, 3x por semana no escritório! próximo da estação Fradique Coutinho/Faria Lima.

title: Testing & commissioning Engineer

  • Preparing project documentation, including test reports, commissioning plans, and equipment manuals;
  • Participate in project meetings and effectively communicate with stakeholders to achieve project goals.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field is preferred;
  • Proven experience in testing and commissioning power generator preferred;
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to electrical testing and commissioning (E.g., IEEE, IEC, NEC);
  • Strong troubleshooting abilities and capacity to analyze complex electrical systems;
  • Experience in project management or coordination is a plus;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team;
  • Strong commitment to safety and quality;
  • This position may require travel to project sites or customer locations, both locally and internationally as needed.

title: Risk Management Manager
description:
As the Safety Risk Manager, you will play a pivotal role in building the future of safety risk

management at Keeta.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Lead data analysis and modeling for platform risk scenarios
  • Conduct risk identification, classification, and early-warning analysis across rider/driver/courier, merchant, and customer segments.
  • Perform bottom-up data discovery and metric construction
  • Conduct in-depth EDA using raw mobility/delivery platform data (orders, location traces, incentives, behavioral logs).
  • Build standardized risk metrics, operational metrics, behavior features, and monitoring indicators from the ground up.
  • Apply top-down business perspective to drive strategy and execution
  • Work closely with product, operations, policy, and risk teams to translate high-level business goals into measurable and actionable metrics.
  • Drive 0→1 metric system design for new markets or new products, and evolve metrics for rapid growth and later-stage refinement.
  • Develop dashboards and risk monitoring systems
  • Build and maintain BI dashboards to monitor key risk, quality, safety, and operational metrics.
  • Detect anomalies, conduct root-cause analysis, and support incident response and post-mortem reviews.
  • Support cross-functional decision making and risk strategy design
  • Provide data-driven insights to support risk mitigation strategies, counter-measure design, operational policy updates, and business optimization.
  • Evaluate the impact of policy or product changes, and create closed-loop measurement frameworks.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations Research, Data Science, or related fields.


Technical Skills


  • Proficient in SQL and Python/R for data processing, modeling, and analysis.
  • Solid knowledge of machine learning methods (logistic regression, decision trees, anomaly detection, clustering) is preferred.
  • Strong ability to understand raw data structures and build robust metric definitions.
  • Risk Experience (Core Requirement)
  • Experience in risk analytics, trust & safety, fraud detection, operational risk, or platform governance—preferably in mobility, delivery, or other two-sided marketplace industries.
  • Familiar with risk assessment lifecycle: identification → quantification → monitoring → mitigation.
  • Bottom-Up Analytical Capability
  • Ability to investigate raw data (orders, trajectory data, incentives, cancellations, GPS signals, courier/driver behavior) and derive structured metrics and actionable insights.
  • Top-Down Business and Strategy Thinking
  • Ability to understand business models such as supply-demand balancing, delivery SLA, driver/courier incentives, merchant performance, and safety/quality frameworks.
  • Proven experience in designing and scaling 0→1→N metric systems supporting business objectives.
  • Project Experience (strong preferred but not necessary)
  • Experience supporting new market entry, new product launches, or rapid-scale operations is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical reasoning, structured communication, and data storytelling abilities.
  • Ability to convert complex analysis into clear, practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with high attention to detail.

  • Concluir o trabalho atribuído dentro dos prazos e comunicar o status caso haja risco de atraso nas entregas.
  • Configurar e gerenciar espaços de colaboração de projetos (Confluence) e sistemas de gestão de tarefas/issues (Jira).

  • Fornecer demonstrações e treinamentos de sistemas de eCommerce para clientes.
  • Revisar análises pré-existentes para melhorar KPIs.
  • Desenvolver planos de teste, escrever scripts de teste e definir critérios de aceitação.


Experiência

  1. 2–3 anos de experiência total, com participação em pelo menos 3 projetos de implementação Hybris.

  3. Compreensão sólida do SAP Hybris Application Lifecycle Framework.
  4. Experiência em consultoria de gestão nas áreas de estratégia de negócios/TI, governança, gestão de valor, gestão de processos e Centro de Excelência.

  7. Experiência em análise de dados para gerar conclusões relevantes para o negócio e utilização de técnicas/ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  8. Fortes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal, incluindo redação técnica.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Incentive Planning
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Collaborate with sales teams to evaluate execution effectiveness, identify gaps, and iteratively refine sales strategies to ensure solution viability.

  4. Strong work planning skills, meticulous, and highly responsible for deliverables.


What Makes This Role Exciting

  1. Target performance is one of the key levers to drive the sales team to achieve the company's overall goals, with strong implementation feasibility.

4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Product Designer
description:
About the Company



Hi, we’re Actabl. We’re providing better solutions for hotel companies as the world around us evolves and changes related to using technology, finding labor, and maximizing profits. Our mission is to empower the people that power hospitality. We give hoteliers actionable insights to know what to do, the tools to do it, and the visibility to know it worked. We bring together powerful hospitality tech solutions to maximize profits for more than 10,000 properties in hospitality markets around the world.



Our Valued Behaviors


  • Start with People: We are in the hospitality business and hospitality starts with people. This impacts both our being and our doing.
  • Being: We are responsible for building relationships, earning trust, and having fun. These things are fundamental to hospitality.
  • Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together.
  • Demand Integrity: Be trustworthy, be ethical, and be consistent whether someone is watching or not. Demand integrity of yourself and others to build the fabric of a high-integrity organization.
  • Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted.
  • Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily.
  • Make it Happen: We show up prepared, care about the details, and follow through. Don't get distracted. Don't stop at blockers. Don't make excuses. Find a way and drive until it is done.



About Actabl's Product Design Team


We redefine expectations

We treat SaaS with the same passion and craft you’d expect from world-class consumer products. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact.


Bellhop Design System

Our young design system is called Bellhop because it was inspired by the essence of hospitality. It's a scalable and cohesive system made to empower people who power hospitality. Check out Actabl Design here .



Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end design across features and flows, from discovery to delivery.
  • Collaborate with PMs and engineers to shape problem spaces, define requirements, and validate solutions.
  • Design intuitive, scalable interfaces for enterprise SaaS products with heavy use of dashboards, complex data tables, and operational workflows .
  • Run user interviews, synthesize insights, and convert them into actionable design decisions.
  • Produce high-quality UI/UX deliverables: journeys, wireframes, flows, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, tables, dashboards, etc.
  • Work closely with our design system team to maintain consistency and push our standards forward.
  • Advocate for user experience and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams.
  • Incorporate AI tools, Vibe Coding, and rapid prototyping into your process to increase velocity and quality.
  • Understand our products, personas, their journeys, and JTBD.



You as a Product Designer

Ideal Profile


You are not a “by the books” Product Designer and have at least 3 years of experience, strong design craft, and excellent communication skills. You are comfortable with high-density enterprise SaaS interfaces such as dashboards and data grids, and you work confidently with design systems and cross-functional teams.


  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer (UX/UI) in tech or SaaS companies.
  • Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Living in Brazil.
  • Strong product thinking, ability to break down complexity, understand constraints, frame problems, and propose pragmatic solutions.
  • Excellent English communication (major stakeholders are native english speakers)
  • Solid experience designing for enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Comfortable crafting elegant high-density interfaces.
  • Experience working with design systems (tokens, components, libraries).
  • Strong craft with an attention to detail.
  • Portfolio demonstrating clear thinking, strong fundamentals, and high-quality craft.'


Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI prototyping tools (e.g., Figma Make, V0, Claude Code).
  • Experience integrating AI into design workflows.
  • Familiarity with hospitality, operational tools, or B2B workflows.



Work Environment:

Location: Full-remote Brasil.

Connectivity: Requires a reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup.

Equipment: The company provides necessary equipment (laptop, monitor, peripherals).

Travel: Occasional travel may be required. A valid driver's license may be required for travel.

Work Hours: Employees are expected to be available during core business hours to ensure collaboration with team members and stakeholders.

Communication: Regular communication via video calls, chat applications, and email is expected.


Additional Information

  • Full-remote job position
  • You will be hired as a contractor (PJ)

Para nós da Piadina Romagnola, toda refeição deve ser gostosa e saudável. Uma refeição rápida pode ter um atendimento com atenção e empatia. Uma refeição rápida não precisa ser cheia de gorduras, frituras e alimentos processados. E por fim, comida saudável não precisa ser sem graça.

title: IT Business Analyst – Transportation Management
description:
Position Summary


The Solution Delivery Organization is fully aligned with ADM’s enterprise process framework and the AE/GPO (Accountable Executive/Global Process Owner) structure, supporting business technology strategy development, solution discovery, service management, risk mitigation and relationship management.


Within the Transportation Management (TM) domain, the team enables all processes and capabilities related to planning, execution, visibility and optimization of transportation.

As part of the TM Solution Delivery team, the Senior Business Analyst – TM will analyze business processes, gather functional requirements, and collaborate with Solution Leaders, Process & System Analysts, and business stakeholders to design, document, and deliver robust TM solutions that support ADM’s global strategy.


Job Responsibilities


• Partner with Product Owners, business representatives and Solution Delivery team members during preliminary investigations for new solutions, ensuring clear requirements gathering, data analysis and evaluation of solution options.

• Contribute to the design and revision of processes following enterprise governance standards.

• Understand cross-process and cross-functional dependencies while designing, developing and implementing TM solutions.

• Prepare documentation for key project phases, including requirement gathering, discovery, development and delivery.

• Collaborate with Solution Architects to translate strategy documents into actionable roadmaps and participate in regular roadmap reviews.

• Work closely with other IT delivery teams to ensure efficient end-to-end solution deployment.

• Collaborate with external vendors (software, applications, tools) to clarify business requirements and support system analysts in building functionalities.

• Support roadmap execution for implementation projects, ensuring alignment with stakeholders and service delivery teams.

• Maintain high visibility on solution and service delivery activities through updates, meetings and communication with team leads.

• Analyze incoming requests, ensuring deliverables are well defined and aligned with stakeholders.

• Provide accurate status updates and documentation for assigned projects, enhancements and support activities.

• Contribute to estimates of time and resource needs for proposed solutions.

• Support transition of project deliverables into the support organization through documentation and knowledge transfer.

• Partner with other process and system experts to identify continuous improvement opportunities.


Job Requirements


• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business or related field, with 5+ years of experience in IT or business process roles.

• Strong understanding of Transportation Management processes (planning, execution, carrier management, freight visibility), and familiarity with major TM solutions.

• Ability to interact professionally with all levels of the organization.

• Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.

• Ability to work occasional weekends, holidays or overtime when necessary.

• Willingness to travel to support business objectives.

• Ability to work independently and in multicultural teams.

• Strong analytical, organizational, time-management, facilitation and process-management skills.

• Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Ability to adapt to fast-paced environments, reprioritize, and handle evolving assignments.

• Knowledge of emerging trends and process solutions related to Transportation Management.

• Fluency in Portuguese and English .

title: Account Executive - Marketing Solutions
description:
São Paulo/SP - Brazil


SiiLA is the dominant authority in commercial real estate news, data, and analysis across Latin America. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a reputation for delivering precise , reliable market intelligence with a relentless commitment to quality and integrity .


Powered by cutting-edge technology, SiiLA transforms raw data into actionable insights through subscription-based solutions trusted by the world’s top commercial real estate professionals. Our platform offers unparalleled transparency , empowering clients to make informed decisions in a rapidly evolving industry.


Visit our website: siila.com.br


About the Role:

Are you passionate about commercial real estate, technology, and helping others succeed? SiiLA is looking for an Account Executive who combines business acumen with a consultative approach to selling.

This is not just a sales role—it’s an opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing organization where your efforts will directly influence our continued success. We’re looking for someone who is eager to become an expert in our products, understands the nuances of the commercial real estate industry, and embraces the challenge of developing long-term client relationships.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a deep understanding of SiiLA’s products, data, and the commercial real estate market to build credibility and be a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Understand the Platform's Advertising Features: Gain a deep knowledge of the platform’s advertising offerings, tools, and capabilities to effectively showcase the benefits to potential clients and maximize their value.
  • Strategize Advertising Solutions: Work closely with the marketing team to design customized advertising solutions for clients, utilizing platform features to target the right audience and enhance commercial real estate market visibility.
  • Client Consultation & Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding clients’ needs and leveraging the platform’s advertising tools to achieve their business objectives, particularly in the commercial real estate sector.
  • Actively identify and qualify new business opportunities, leveraging a consultative selling approach to tailor solutions to client needs.
  • Engage with prospects through persistent outreach, effective listening, and thoughtful presentations to communicate SiiLA’s value proposition.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Continuously monitor the performance of advertising campaigns on the platform, providing clients with insights and recommendations to optimize their campaigns.
  • Educate Clients on the Platform’s Value: Conduct presentations, training sessions, and workshops to educate clients on effectively using the platform’s advertising features, fostering long-term client relationships and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product Development: Provide feedback to the product development team regarding client needs and industry trends, helping to refine and enhance the platform’s advertising benefits for greater market relevance.
  • Drive Client Acquisition & Retention: Proactively identify opportunities to acquire new clients and retain existing ones by showcasing the unique advantages and results that the platform’s advertising solutions deliver within the commercial real estate market.
  • Stay Current with Industry Trends: Keep updated with digital advertising and commercial real estate trends to ensure the platform remains competitive and aligned with market demands.
  • Take initiative to experiment, refine processes, and share ideas to help SiiLA scale in the Brazil Market and beyond.
  • Build strong relationships with prospects, clients, and industry stakeholders, maintaining trust and delivering value .
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and exceptional client experiences .

What Makes You a Great Fit:

·      Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

·      A minimum of three years of experience in Marketing sales, preferably within commercial real estate, technology, or a related industry.

·      Strong business sense with the ability to qualify prospects effectively and identify opportunities for tailored solutions in Marketing.

·      A natural curiosity and willingness to dive into data, technology, and market trends to build expertise and credibility.

·      Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to contribute to the growth of a fast-evolving organization and make a measurable impact.

·      Excellent interpersonal skills and clear, effective communication in both English and Portuguese.

·      Persistence and resilience in handling objections, with the ability to bounce back and stay motivated .

·      Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities, stay on top of leads, and deliver results .

·      Confidence and presence to engage with executives while remaining personable and approachable.

·      Coachable and adaptable , with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to apply feedback effectively.


Follow us: @siila.br

description:

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the job

As Collections Specialist, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy, policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You’ll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You’ll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix’s collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil’s legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.


Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

  • Avaliar e implantar softwares e métodos de gestão de projetos, assegurando documentação estruturada e padronização de processos.
  • Promover reuniões de acompanhamento (diárias, semanais e mensais) com as equipes envolvidas, garantindo alinhamento e ritmo nas entregas.
  • Implantar e aprimorar ferramentas de gestão de projetos e governanças corporativas que garantam análises de viabilidade técnicas e financeiras de forma ágil e padronizada.

  • Liderar o calendário de business reports , consolidando resultados, impacto financeiro, desvios críticos e aprendizados.

  • Construir e monitorar o pipeline de projetos , com SLAs e indicadores de eficiência (tempo, esforço, retorno, margem).
  • Mapear recursos necessários (financeiros, humanos e técnicos) e propor otimizações de alocação.
  • Estruturar o pool de oportunidades da companhia, centralizando ideias, mensurando impactos e apoiando a tomada de decisão executiva.
  • Coordenar o Comitê LATAM , garantindo integração de governança com México e Argentina.


Formação:

  • Graduação completa (Administração, Engenharia, Química ou áreas correlatas);
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações (PMP, Scrum Master, Lean, PM², etc.) são diferenciais.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de portfólio de projetos , preferencialmente em empresas B2B industriais, químicas ou de distribuição.
  • Vivência em implantação de PMO , gestão de performance e estruturação de governança.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica e habilidade para conectar estratégia, operação e resultado financeiro .
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para conduzir fóruns executivos multidisciplinares.


Local de trabalho : Pinheiros, São Paulo - SP

Modelo híbrido : 3 dias presencial na semana

Horário de trabalho : Segunda à sexta-feira das 8h00 às 17h45

title: Coordenador de Vendas
description:
Na Rheem , estamos empenhados em trazer conveniência à vida das pessoas e como fabricante líder mundial de equipamentos de aquecimento de água e ar condicionado, estamos focados em inovar formas completamente novas de fornecer os produtos certos, ao mesmo tempo que poupamos energia, água e apoiamos um futuro mais brilhante e sustentável.

É um desafio emocionante que requer uma equipe de pessoas talentosas e apaixonadas com um conjunto diversificado de competências, onde operadores de produção, engenheiros, contadores, profissionais de vendas e especialistas em áreas de suporte são chamados a impulsionar a inovação.

Junte-se à Rheem e ajude-nos a moldar o futuro de produtos que impactam a vida das pessoas, todos os dias!


Candidate-se para fazer parte da nossa equipe!


Procuramos um Coordenador de Vendas que será responsável por atender o mercado e região de Sudeste , com foco em aumentar o market share de todas as linhas de produtos e abranger todo o mercado. Liderar a equipe de vendas, direta ou indiretamente, fornecendo aos clientes soluções de todas as linhas de produtos e atendendo aos objetivos estratégicos e financeiros da empresa em sua região.


Funções principais:


  • Supervisionar e orientar a equipe de representantes de vendas para garantir que eles atinjam os objetivos estabelecidos de vendas e receitas de todas as linhas de produto.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas eficazes para maximizar o desempenho e a eficiência da equipe.
  • Liderança de equipe: Realize treinamentos regulares para melhorar as habilidades de vendas da equipe e garantir o conhecimento do produto.
  • Monitorar e analisar tendências de mercado e dados de vendas para identificar oportunidades de crescimento e ameaças ao desempenho.
  • Resolver problemas/conflitos para os membros da sua equipe e grupos de clientes na sua região de responsabilidade.
  • Estabelecer e manter relacionamentos sólidos com os principais clientes e parceiros de negócios para impulsionar as vendas e a satisfação do cliente.
  • Gerenciar a equipe de vendas através da metodologia adotada pela empresa.
  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho e apresentar análises à alta administração, destacando os resultados obtidos e fornecendo informações para ações futuras.
  • Implementar e fazer cumprir as políticas e procedimentos da empresa, garantindo conformidade e ética nas práticas de vendas.
  • Resolver conflitos e questões relacionadas às vendas, tanto internamente quanto com clientes, de forma rápida e eficaz.


Requisitos principais

  • Profissional Universitário nas áreas de Administração, Marketing, Comercial ou similares
  • 5 anos de experiência como Supervisor, Coordenador de Vendas ou cargo similar
  • Entre 5 a 10 anos de experiência na área técnica de vendas
  • Desejável experiência em empresa do setor de manufatura industrial
  • Disponibilidade para viajar para a região sudeste
  • Desejável Excel intermediario
  • Desejável do idioma español

title: Estagiário de engenharia civil
description:
Quer fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência? A Habras é o lugar certo para você!




Descrição da vaga



Quem somos?

O nosso maior ativo são as pessoas. Nosso compromisso com a excelência começa com nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais altamente qualificados e dedicados.

Acreditamos no impacto transformador de uma habitação de qualidade e, por isso, investimos em equipamentos e ferramentas que garantam mais eficiência e rentabilidade em nossas obras.

Buscamos sempre soluções que estejam enquadradas com políticas socioambientais, minimizando o impacto no meio ambiente e contribuindo para a comunidade na qual estamos inseridos.

Nos dedicamos a projetos que inspiram e refletem a nossa solidez. Não construímos apenas edifícios; construímos lares, conexões e futuros brilhantes!
